details.effect: [evolve][cost02]: Evolve this follower. [evolve] Discard 3 cards: Evolve this follower. Aura. This card can't be destroyed by abilities. (It can still be destroyed by ability damage.)

issues: The evolve abilities are encoded incorrectly. The card should have two `timing: "evolve"` abilities that evolve this follower: one with `cost: {"pp":2}` and one with a discard-3 cost, rather than a 0-PP evolve keyword ability and a discard effect without the evolve result.
The card is missing its Aura ability 'This card can't be destroyed by abilities.' Add a passive/aura ability using `grantIndestructible` or equivalent continuous self-protection effect.
The card should not list `evolve` as a keyword here; the printed text is an evolve cost line, which should be represented by evolve abilities/costs instead.

details.effect: Aura. On Evolve: For the rest of this turn and during each opponent's next turn, this follower doesn't take damage. This card can't be destroyed by abilities.

issues: The card incorrectly has the `ward` keyword; remove it because the source text does not grant Ward.
The card is missing its Aura ability 'This card can't be destroyed by abilities.' Add a passive/aura self-protection ability with `grantIndestructible` or equivalent.

The On Evolve effect is incomplete: the source says 'for the rest of this turn and during each opponent's next turn, this follower doesn't take damage,' but the encoding only gives generic damage immunity with no next-opponent-turn duration handling.
